title: Prefill/Decode attention hinting and selective kernel probing for low-overhead runtime telemetry
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Our current prefill/decode telemetry relies on coarse NVTX ranges and dense span instrumentation which gives high-fidelity kernel attribution but adds measurable overhead on tail latency and scheduler variability. Goal: design and ship an adaptive, low-overhead telemetry mode that uses attention-based hinting to selectively probe kernel performance. This ticket covers the design, prototype, and canary rollout of the selective kernel probing agent and associated trace/span naming conventions.
acceptance_criteria: A working probe agent that can toggle between dense NVTX and selective probe modes via runtime flag
Selective probes add <2% median latency overhead and <6% 95th percentile overhead on our canary benchmark compared to no-instrumentation baseline
Per-kernel attribution accuracy >=85% for top-3 contributing kernels when compared to dense NVTX ground truth
Trace/span model includes model_id, batch_id, sequence_length_bin, route_tag, and kernel_variant tags
Dashboard panel (metrics.redwood/runtime/telemetry/selective_probes) published with breakdown by sequence_length_bin and probe_cohort
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya Chen: Filed initial ticket after spike showed 9% tail overhead with current full NVTX instrumentation on v1.19 microbenchmarks. Proposed adaptive approach: sample inside attention hotspots only.

2026-02-17 Rajesh Patel: Design review notes — add stratified sampling by sequence length and route, prefer reservoir sampling for long-tail sequences. Will prototype a lightweight 'hint' emitted by attention planner when keys/queries exceed threshold.

2026-02-24 Design review (Sofia Alvarez): UX for traces looks good; suggested standardized span names: runtime.prefill.<phase> and runtime.kernel.<kernel_name> with .probe suffix when sampled. Also requested tag kernel_variant and kernel_selector_hint.

2026-03-02 Engineering update (Rajesh Patel): Prototype agent implemented. It inserts NVTX-like pseudo-ranges (userland timers surfaced to trace exporter) only when attention-hint >= 0.8 or reservoir sample hit. Added per-kernel lightweight counters exported via prometheus client with labels: model_id, kernel_name, seq_bin, cohort.

2026-03-05 QA (Evelyn Brooks): Canary microbench shows probe mode median overhead 0.9% and 95th overhead 4.7% on small-request mix. For long-sequence mix (>=2048) reservoir sampling rate needs tuning — observed 12% misses in attribution vs ground truth.

2026-03-09 Rajesh Patel: Adjusted sampling policy: increase reservoir window for sequences >1024 and prioritize first-accelerated-pass in prefill. Added a conservative fallback: if scheduler latency jitter > threshold, temporarily switch to dense NVTX for one minute to re-calibrate.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Code review completed for tracing name harmonization and span tags. Merged telemetry schema changes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2819. Preparing canary rollout notes and dashboard panels.

2026-03-12 Ops note (Liam O'Connor): Canary scheduled for cluster canary-telemetry-2 on 2026-03-15, will monitor metrics: runtime.telemetry.probe_overhead, runtime.kernel.attribution_accuracy, and the new panel runtime-telemetry/selective_probes. If customer-impact > medium, rollback and open postmortem.
